params.prompt:
Repaint this blockout video as a finished hand-painted gouache animation. VERTICAL 9:16 portrait frame, frame for frame: keep the exact camera move, framing, timing and every pose from the source video, and paint only what each source frame shows, adding no other characters or objects.

Character: the flame-shaped figure is Sol, exactly the mascot in the reference images (the turnaround sheet shows his shape from every side; the strip of faces shows every eye shape he makes in this shot). Round, plump gumdrop body with a red outer layer, an orange middle layer and a broad cream inner flame for the face. At rest his face is plain smooth cream with exactly two small tall navy #1C2447 oval eyes set low and close together, solid dark with no whites or highlights, and nothing else on it: nothing is drawn above his eyes and nothing below them. His eyes change ONLY as the beats below say; copy his eyes from each source frame exactly, the same shape, size and place. Short stubby rounded red-orange arm nubs and two tiny blunt stubby red feet; his arm nubs stay the same short length in every frame and never stretch or grow. Sol wears nothing. Sol gives off no sparks, particles or smoke. His layers and face move together as one body with a small soft wobble that settles. He keeps the same size and the same place in the frame as in the source video. The small floating marks near him (music notes, an exclamation mark, a sweat drop, dots, a light bulb, a star, yellow dashes) appear ONLY in the frames where the source video shows them, in the same place and size, and vanish when the source stops showing them.

Scene: a small sunny bathroom, inside a white bathtub alcove. The tub floor is smooth glossy white. The walls of the alcove are pale aqua square tiles with white grout lines. Warm daylight with soft cool shadows, so the room has depth and glow. On the far wall are one silver shower head, one round window glowing with warm cream light, one small white shelf holding one coral bottle, one lilac bottle and one yellow rubber duck, and one silver lever tap; none of them ever moves or changes. The shower is running: blue water drops fall straight down from the shower head in a narrow spray and land in one round pale-blue puddle on the tub floor. Paint the drops as falling water, exactly where the source video shows them. Along the left side of the tub hangs ONE mustard-yellow shower curtain with soft vertical pleats and a pale cream band along its bottom hem, on one silver rod with silver rings. CURTAIN RULE: it is the same single curtain in every frame, the same colour, with the same pleats and the same cream hem; it bends and swings ONLY as the source video shows and never tears, opens, wraps around Sol or changes length. 

Beats: 1. Sol stands beside the curtain, turned toward it; its cream hem hangs right at his side. In the first quarter second his eyes are two navy half-rings with white centres, each cut flat across its top and slanted down toward the middle of his face and the top of his flame is a deeper red. 2. At 0.25 seconds the red is gone and he is his normal orange and red from then to the last frame. His eyes become two sideways chevrons with rounded tips, pointing at each other like > <, and he leans back away from the curtain. From 0.4 to 1.4 seconds he flaps both short arm nubs up and down in turn, fast, six flaps, slapping at the curtain, and his body rocks with each flap. FLAP RULE: the nubs stay the same short length and only swing up and down at his sides; they never stretch toward the curtain. The curtain's hem flutters a little with each flap. 3. At 1.4 seconds the curtain swings in and at 1.5 seconds its hem bumps into him; the camera jolts. His eyes become two round navy rings with white centres and he holds still with both nubs raised until 2.1 seconds. 4. From 1.7 to 2.6 seconds the camera swings round to face him and then pushes in slowly. At 2.15 seconds his eyes are two navy ovals again; he lowers his nubs, turns to the camera and looks up. He blinks once at 2.75 seconds. 5. From 3.2 to 4.1 seconds he looks sideways at the curtain and one pale blue sweat drop sits on the upper right side of his face; at 4.2 seconds the drop is gone. 6. At 4.7 seconds he nods once. In the final quarter second his two navy oval eyes are open. GROUND RULE: his feet rest on the tub floor in every frame and his shadow lies under his feet. 

Style: the painted reference frame is the LAST moment of the shot just before this one, in the same film. This shot continues from it: the same bathroom, the same aqua tiles, the same yellow curtain with its cream hem, the same shallow pale-blue puddle of water on the white tub floor under Sol, the same paint treatment and light, and the same Sol, who starts this shot with the same slanted glare eyes and deeper red flame top. Do not copy the reference frame's camera angle; take every object's place and every pose from the source video. Soft matte gouache painting with visible brushwork, broad simplified shapes, layered colour, softened painted edges and subtle paper texture on Sol, the props and the room alike. Forms defined by light and colour. No ink outlines, no black linework, not glossy 3D, not vector art. Smooth natural motion, no motion blur, stable background paint texture. No text, no letters, no captions, no speech, no music.
